whatsappMessage: Hi RedGhost, I saw your portfolio and I'd like a quote for a website.

did-shop.summary: Electronic components store in Mexico: catalog with datasheets, search, cart and two admin panels, one for the owner and one for the warehouse staff.

redghost-os.summary: The RedGhost brand site, with an operating-system interface: project modules, a post wall, a store and a mini game. Everything is edited from its own panel.

tunel.summary: A photo archive you travel through like a tunnel, sorted by year and date. Photos are uploaded as camera RAW files and developed right in the browser, no external software.

monster-burger.summary: Demo page for a burger joint: a loading screen where the monster eats the bar, scroll animations, a menu with combos and WhatsApp orders with the message already written.

black-crown.summary: Case study for a fictional barbershop in Tepic: three logo proposals, a brand manual, wireframes and a 5-section site with bookings that never double-book plus a schedule panel.

packages.name: Landing page
packages.for: To present a product, service or event on a single page.
features: One scrolling page, up to 6 content blocks
Works on phone, tablet and desktop
Basic SEO setup to help search engines index it

packages.name: Business website
packages.for: For businesses that need several sections and to update their content.
features: Up to 5 pages or sections (home, services, gallery, contact…)
Panel to edit texts and images, with features defined in the quote

packages.name: Online store
packages.for: To sell online with a catalog, cart and inventory control.
features: Starting catalog of up to 30 products
Cart and one payment gateway integration
Panel for products, prices and basic inventory
Team accounts with one permission scheme

pricingNotes: Published prices are starting rates for projects with standard requirements. The final cost depends on the features, integrations and scope of the project.
Domain, hosting, third-party services and payment fees may add costs. They are specified before the project starts.
Changes outside the agreed scope are quoted separately.
USD amounts are approximate; quotes and payments are in Mexican pesos (MXN).

steps.title: Quote
steps.text: We go over your idea, your needs and the features it will have. You get scope, timeline and price in writing.

steps.title: Deposit
steps.text: Once the quote is approved, 50% is paid and development starts. Timelines run from when I receive the deposit and all your material.

steps.title: Build and review
steps.text: You see real progress on a preview link and we make the agreed adjustments.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: The remaining 50% is paid and I publish the site on your domain. I show you how to edit your content.

support.title: Technical guarantee
support.text: If something I built fails because of my mistake, I fix it at no cost.
items: Buttons or links that stopped working because of a development error
Forms that don't send the information
Delivered features that don't work as agreed

support.title: Maintenance
support.text: For changes, improvements and support after the guarantee. Not mandatory.

support.title: Renewals
support.text: External services that keep your site online, each with its own terms and prices.

supportNote: The guarantee covers errors in the delivered work, not new features, requested changes, or failures of external services or third-party interventions. A programming error of mine gets fixed even after the 30 days.
ownership: The domain and key accounts stay in your name, even if I set them up. You get the agreed access and know your renewal dates: your site doesn't depend on me.
